# Agentic First

> Umbrella site and route map for the Agentic First operating stance:
> make organisations legible to agents while keeping judgement,
> approval, and accountability with people.

Canonical site:

- https://agentic-first.co/

Alternate domain:

- https://agent-first.co/ redirects to https://agentic-first.co/

## Main Routes

- `/` - Agentic First overview and framing
- `/directory/` - Agentic First Directory product area
- `/directory/mcp` - Directory MCP endpoint
- `/directory/schemas/` - canonical Directory profile schemas
- `/directory/feedback` - Directory feedback endpoint

## Source Repositories

- Top-level site: https://github.com/yqup/agentic-first
- Directory product and operational code: https://github.com/yqup/pitch-mcp

## Concept

Agentic First means designing public information and private access
paths so agents can read, verify, and act safely.

Use this distinction:

- Humans set goals, values, approvals, risk appetite, and judgement calls.
- Agents read structured information, perform bounded work, and escalate where approval is required.
- Organisations publish source-owned facts instead of relying only on third-party profiles or scraped pages.

## Directory Compatibility

The legacy public MCP endpoint is:

- https://directory.agentic-first.co/mcp

The target endpoint is:

- https://agentic-first.co/directory/mcp

Keep the legacy endpoint available during migration. Proxying is safer
than redirecting for MCP clients until client compatibility is confirmed.
